title: Coast Guard Member Helps Save 120 Haitian Migrants
description: Petty Officer 3rd Class Samantha Constant and her shipmates on the Coast Guard Cutter Northland rescued 120 Haitian migrants from an overloaded vessel. Constant’s Haitian language skills were crucial to averting a catastrophe and showcasing how diversity is an operational imperative. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Jetta Disco.
pass_reason: interview feature with burned-in captions and a medical scene
